title: Modbus Configuration
description: Connect to one or more Modbus devices over TCP or RS232/RS485 serial (RTU).

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Each connection is a TCP endpoint or a serial port, with the devices reached over it. Click 'Add' to add a connection, or use Auto-configure to discover devices on them (none: it probes 127.0.0.1:502).

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: How does your device communicate? Select TCP for Ethernet/IP connections, or RTU for RS232/RS485 serial.

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional name for this connection in the trace (defaults to the host address or serial port)

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Modbus devices (unit IDs) on this connection. They share the link and are polled one request at a time. Click 'Add' to add a device.

unit_id.title: Unit ID
unit_id.description: Modbus slave/unit ID of the target device

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional name for this device in the trace (defaults to unit<ID>, e.g. unit1)

register_map.title: Register Map
register_map.description: Where the device's register map comes from: a JSON file, or SunSpec discovery at connect (read-only, for SunSpec inverters, meters and batteries).

rate.title: Rate (seconds)
rate.description: Poll rate for registers without their own rate. Empty: the Advanced default rate (auto-scanned devices: Auto-scan Rate). 0 = not polled, no auto-scan (actions still read and write).

register_map_file.title: Register Map File
register_map_file.description: JSON file that defines which registers to read and how to decode them. A path on the agent's host: absolute or starting with ~. Empty: auto-scan (below).

auto_scan.title: Auto-scan
auto_scan.description: Without a register map file: at start, discover the device's valid registers with reads only (FC 01-04; holding, input, coils, discrete inputs) and poll each one as it is found, every Advanced Auto-scan Rate, traced as registers/<address> (input_registers/, coils/, discrete_inputs/). Off: nothing is polled without a map. Save Map turns what it found into a map file.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the Modbus TCP device

serial_port.title: Serial Port
serial_port.description: Device path for the RS232/RS485 adapter (e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0 on Linux, COM3 on Windows). Choose from the ports on the machine running the agent, or type a path.

baudrate.title: Baudrate
baudrate.description: Serial communication speed — must match the device setting

parity.title: Parity
parity.description: Error-checking parity bit — must match the device setting

stopbits.title: Stop Bits
stopbits.description: Number of stop bits — must match the device setting

bytesize.title: Data Bits
bytesize.description: Number of data bits per frame — must match the device setting

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Settings that apply to every connection and device.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Leading trace source every connection publishes under, so events read '<prefix>/<connection>/<device>/<event>'. Clear it to give each connection its own trace source with events '<device>/<event>'.

default_rate.title: Default Rate (seconds)
default_rate.description: Poll rate for devices and registers that set none. Slower registers are spread one read per tick so they never stall the fastest.

auto_scan_rate.title: Auto-scan Rate (seconds)
auto_scan_rate.description: Poll rate for registers found by auto-scan (devices without a register map) when the device sets no Rate. Slow by default: every register found is polled.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long to wait for a response before retrying

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Extra attempts per request before it counts as failed. Each failed request costs timeout x (1 + retries).

request_delay_ms.title: Request Delay (ms)
request_delay_ms.description: Minimum gap between consecutive requests on a connection. For RS485 gateways and slow RTU devices.

connect_delay_ms.title: Connect Delay (ms)
connect_delay_ms.description: Pause after each (re)connect before the first request, for devices that drop requests sent right after accepting a connection.

demote_after.title: Demote After (timeouts)
demote_after.description: Consecutive timeouts before a device is skipped, so a dead device cannot stall the others on its connection. It is probed with one request after 10 s, doubling up to Demote Max.

demote_max_s.title: Demote Max (seconds)
demote_max_s.description: Longest wait between probes of a demoted device.

block_reads.title: Block Reads
block_reads.description: Coalesce contiguous registers into range reads (far fewer transactions per sweep)

max_block_size.title: Max Block Size
max_block_size.description: Maximum registers per range read (a register map 'device' block overrides it)

max_bit_block_size.title: Max Bit Block Size
max_bit_block_size.description: Maximum coils or discrete inputs per range read (a register map 'device' block overrides it)

max_read_gap.title: Max Read Gap
max_read_gap.description: Maximum uncovered registers to bridge within a block (0 = strictly contiguous)

write_mode.title: Write Mode
write_mode.description: Function code for single-register writes. 'auto' uses FC 6; 'fc16' always uses FC 16 (required by some devices).

allow_raw_writes.title: Allow Raw Writes
allow_raw_writes.description: Let Write Single Register, Write Registers and Write Coil write any address, bypassing the register map. Off: only registers a map marks writable can be written (by name). On: addresses the map marks read-only are still refused.
